description: Airtable Web API for reading and writing bases, tables and records, with webhooks and MCP.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens, both sent in an Authorization Bearer header; legacy API keys are deprecated.
gate_detail: Personal access tokens are available on all plan types and are created by users themselves; OAuth integrations are registered at /create/oauth. Enterprise admins can limit token lifetime or allowlist MCP integrations.
api_scope: Web API for bases and records with scopes and per-base access, plus webhooks and an MCP server for AI tools.
mcp_notes: Airtable documents its own MCP server in developer docs and support; setup uses OAuth or personal access tokens. No URL given.
blocker_detail: Enterprise admin policies may restrict token lifetime or third-party integrations.

evidence.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.
All plan types. Certain features are only available to Enterprise Scale or Business plan customers.
They can be created and managed at [/create/tokens]
